name: Cryptography
description: How modern cryptography works: ciphers, hashes and MACs, public-key systems, signatures and the protocols built from them.

nodes.name: Goals & adversaries
nodes.desc: Confidentiality, integrity, authenticity and Kerckhoffs's principle.

nodes.name: Classical ciphers
nodes.desc: Caesar, Vigenère and substitution ciphers and how to break them.

nodes.name: Perfect secrecy
nodes.desc: One-time pad, Shannon's perfect secrecy and why it is impractical.

nodes.name: Computational security
nodes.desc: Security against efficient adversaries, negligible advantage and pseudorandomness.

nodes.name: Block ciphers & AES
nodes.desc: Block ciphers, substitution-permutation networks and AES.

nodes.name: Stream ciphers
nodes.desc: Pseudorandom generators, ChaCha20 and the danger of nonce reuse.

nodes.name: Modes of operation
nodes.desc: ECB, CBC, CTR and why the mode matters.

nodes.name: Hash functions
nodes.desc: Collision, preimage and second-preimage resistance, SHA-2 and SHA-3.

nodes.name: MACs
nodes.desc: Message authentication codes and HMAC.

nodes.name: AEAD
nodes.desc: Encrypt-then-MAC and AEAD modes like AES-GCM.

nodes.name: Password hashing
nodes.desc: Salts, key stretching, bcrypt, scrypt and Argon2.

nodes.name: Public-key basics
nodes.desc: Key pairs, trapdoor functions and hard problems behind public-key crypto.

nodes.name: RSA
nodes.desc: Key generation, encryption, padding and why textbook RSA is insecure.

nodes.name: Diffie-Hellman
nodes.desc: Key exchange over groups and the discrete logarithm problem.

nodes.name: Elliptic curves
nodes.desc: Elliptic-curve groups, ECDH and why keys are shorter.

nodes.name: Digital signatures
nodes.desc: RSA and ECDSA/EdDSA signatures and hash-then-sign.

nodes.name: PKI & certificates
nodes.desc: Certificates, certificate authorities, chains of trust and revocation.

nodes.name: TLS
nodes.desc: The TLS 1.3 handshake, forward secrecy and record protection.

nodes.name: Attacks & misuse
nodes.desc: Padding oracles, timing side channels and common implementation mistakes.

nodes.name: Zero-knowledge proofs
nodes.desc: Proving a statement without revealing why, and where ZK proofs are used.

nodes.name: Toy RSA project
nodes.desc: Implement RSA key generation, encryption and signing from scratch, then attack weak parameters.

nodes.name: Secure chat project
nodes.desc: Build an end-to-end encrypted chat with key exchange, AEAD and authenticated peers.
